reproduction.result: Three native address Ctrl+F attempts wrote domain1/2/3 into the address instead of find; Ctrl+L did not select the address. Four failures on the original production bundle.

implementation: Replace container bubbling shortcut handling with owner-document Obsidian Scope Mod+F/Mod+L bindings. Only visible focused browser host controls admit the actions.
Release on guest/editor focus, blur, hidden sizing, unmount and window migration. Popout controls use their own document and window.
Modal scope is the parent. A wildcard only consumes a handled Escape, allowing an unhandled Escape to reach the modal dismissal binding; named bindings returning undefined would still shadow it.
Native CDP helper now accepts webview targets as well as host pages for direct guest keyboard verification. No guest shortcut or global user hotkey setting changed.
